title: Kilonovae
description: When two neutron stars merge, a few hundredths of a solar mass of neutron-rich matter is flung out, and in a second it captures neutrons up to gold and platinum. Its radioactive glow fades over days.

puzzle.goal: Ejecta of mass M expanding at speed v stay opaque until their light can diffuse out through opacity κ. Write the time t its glow peaks, with the speed of light c.
puzzle.name: Diffusion time of the ejecta
puzzle.form: sqrt ( κ * M / ( 4 * π * v * c ) )
puzzle.ask: Find t in days for M = @{M} kg (0.05 suns), v = @{v} m/s, k = @{k} m²/kg (lanthanide-rich), c = 2.998e8 m/s.
puzzle.method: Light escapes when the time to random-walk out (∝ κM/rc) equals the time since the blast (r/v): solve for t = r/v.
